participation.context: Set the road, and refused to describe the reason.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the horse knew the turn. You would not name the place you were avoiding, and you did not tell a story about it. You stopped.

title: Chose the long way into town

participation.context: Chose the long way and stopped the conversation.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: The carter named Bishopsgate as straight on. You kept the longer way, and you would not be directed further.
topics: a mile out of the way

title: Kept the longer way at Uxbridge
